say:0:1111102001:0.text: The Quicksand Claws are flush in power and numbers. Remember our plan and stick to it.
say:0:1111102001:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪人多势众，记清咱们的目的。
say:0:1111102001:0.male: The Quicksand Claws are flush in power and numbers. Remember our plan and stick to it.
say:0:1111102001:0.female: The Quicksand Claws are flush in power and numbers. Remember our plan and stick to it.

say:1:1111102002:0.text: Search and rescue, find out where Ferranc is, and don't waste time tangling with their minions.
say:1:1111102002:0.source_cn: 直接救人，找到弗兰克的所在，别浪费时间和小喽啰纠缠。

say:3:1111103004:0.text: Any who steal are considered traitors.

say:4:1111103005:0.text: And traitors must be dealt with...

say:0:1111104001:0.text: They've blocked the road. We can't get through.
say:0:1111104001:0.source_cn: 他们把路挡住了，过不去。

say:1:1111104002:0.text: Keep a low profile and let's figure this out.

say:0:1111105001:0.text: Move quickly, and don't alert the other Claws.
say:0:1111105001:0.source_cn: 小心别惊动其他流沙之爪，动作快点。

say:0:1111106001:0.text: This lot here doesn't seem fit to work.

say:1:1111107002:0.text: Hold on, I'll get you out.

say:0:1111108001:0.text: To think anyone could breach this place.

say:2:1111111002:0.text: Yeah! We all knew that when you and Alsa found out, you'd come and save us!
say:2:1111111002:0.source_cn: 嗯！我们一直相信，要是你和阿尔萨姐姐知道了，一定会来找我们！

say:3:1111111003:0.text: We never stopped hoping, no matter how bad it got!
say:3:1111111003:0.source_cn: 所以不管那些坏家伙怎么欺负人，我们都要坚持下去！

say:6:1111111005:0.text: Sorry, we never should've gone out looking for the treasure...
say:6:1111111005:0.male: Sorry, we never should've gone out looking for the treasure...
say:6:1111111005:0.female: Sorry, we never should've gone out looking for the treasure...

say:9:1111111006:0.text: We really wanted to help Soren and Alsa.
say:9:1111111006:0.source_cn: 我、我们真的很想给索恩和阿尔萨帮忙……

say:10:1111111007:0.text: You're the most helpful while looking after yourselves... Alsa is worried sick!
say:10:1111111007:0.source_cn: 你们能照顾好自己，就是给阿尔萨和我分忧了。那个笨蛋担心...

say:12:1111111008:1.text: Are these pups your kin? Not bad, they've got the eyes of future hunters.
say:12:1111111008:1.source_cn: 这些娃娃就是你的族人？不错，眼神很棒，像是能成为猎人的...

say:13:1111111009:1.source_cn: 但这地方实在不宜久留。先把他们送走？

say:14:1111111010:1.text: Another member of my clan, Simba, is waiting for them in the Thundra Settlement.
say:14:1111111010:1.source_cn: 我的另一个族人，小瑟巴，现在正在雷矛聚落等他们。

say:17:1111111012:1.text: Thundra... Are you talking about my settlement? Do you know our leader, Ulma?
say:17:1111111012:1.source_cn: 雷矛——你们在说我的聚落？难道你们认识我们的领袖，尤玛？

choice_prompt:19:1111111012.text: Thundra... Are you talking about my settlement? Do you know our leader, Ulma?
choice_prompt:19:1111111012.source_cn: 雷矛——你们在说我的聚落？难道你们认识我们的领袖，尤玛？

say:21:1111111013:1.text: I remember! Ulma is the graceful and stunning leader of the leopard tribe!
say:21:1111111013:1.source_cn: 我有印象，尤玛是那位矫健美丽的豹女领袖！

say:24:1111111015:1.text: Ulma! Ulma! She hasn't abandoned her kin!
say:24:1111111015:1.source_cn: 尤玛！尤玛！她没有放弃她的同胞！

say:25:1111111016:1.text: I, Ugar of the Thundra Clan, am too injured to work, so the Quicksand Claws threw me in here with the little ones.
say:25:1111111016:1.source_cn: 我，雷矛的乌格尔，受了伤，干不动重活，所以和这些孩子们...

say:26:1111111017:1.text: If you lend me your trust, I'll guide them back to my home!
say:26:1111111017:1.source_cn: 要是你们信任我，我可以带这几个孩子回雷矛聚落！
say:26:1111111017:1.male: If you lend me your trust, I'll guide them back to my home!
say:26:1111111017:1.female: If you lend me your trust, I'll guide them back to my home!

say:29:1111111018:1.text: You... the Quicksand Claws enslaved you?
say:29:1111111018:1.source_cn: 你……那些流沙之爪，在奴役你们？

say:30:1111111019:1.text: Curse them! If I get the chance, they won't be spared!
say:30:1111111019:1.source_cn: 可恶，可恶可恶可恶！！要是有机会，我绝对不会放过他们！

say:33:1111111020:1.text: Soren, aren't you coming back with us?
say:33:1111111020:1.source_cn: 索恩，你不和我们一起回去吗……？
say:33:1111111020:1.male: Soren, aren't you coming back with us?
say:33:1111111020:1.female: Soren, aren't you coming back with us?

say:34:1111111021:1.text: We're going to challenge the leader of the Quicksand Claws—Ferranc.
say:34:1111111021:1.source_cn: 我们要去挑战流沙之爪的首领，弗兰克。
say:34:1111111021:1.male: We're going to challenge the leader of the Quicksand Claws—Ferranc.
say:34:1111111021:1.female: We're going to challenge the leader of the Quicksand Claws—Ferranc.

say:35:1111111022:1.text: I will personally make him pay for the pain he inflicted on you all. The Quicksand Claws will learn they never should have preyed upon the Uru Clan.
say:35:1111111022:1.source_cn: 他在你们身上施加的恐惧和痛苦，我要让他亲自尝尝。让流沙...

say:36:1111111023:1.text: Do you know where we can find him?

say:37:1111111024:1.text: I heard those bad guys say he's in the <style="highlight">big tent to the north</style>, and that he's really mad and grumpy!
say:37:1111111024:1.source_cn: 我听那些坏家伙说，他们的老大总是在<style=hig...

say:39:1111111026:1.text: It's you who needs to be careful. Stay close to Ugar and he'll watch over you.
say:39:1111111026:1.source_cn: 要小心的是你们。去雷矛聚落的路上，多留心身边的情况，跟...

say:40:1111111027:1.text: Ugh... Alsa is better at this.
say:40:1111111027:1.source_cn: 啧……这话，该让阿尔萨来说。

say:41:1111111028:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's move. It's time for Ferranc to pay.
say:41:1111111028:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's move. It's time for Ferranc to pay.
say:41:1111111028:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's move. It's time for Ferranc to pay.

say:44:1111111014:1.text: That's it! I remember it being called Thundra!
say:44:1111111014:1.source_cn: 就是那里，我记得那个聚落好像是叫雷矛！

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 是那个遭劫商队停靠的聚落？

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 她正在乌尔聚落照看族人

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 她正在乌尔聚落等你们回去！

say:0:1111112001:0.text: Doesn't seem like there's any way to get north!
say:0:1111112001:0.source_cn: 说是弗兰克在北边，但这地方根本没有往北去的路！

say:1:1111112002:0.text: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.
say:1:1111112002:0.source_cn: 如果弗兰克和流沙之爪说的一样火爆又奸诈，那应该藏得很深。
say:1:1111112002:0.male: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.
say:1:1111112002:0.female: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.

say:2:1111112003:0.text: Let's detour along the southern road first.
say:2:1111112003:0.source_cn: 先沿着南方的通路，绕道看看吧。
say:2:1111112003:0.male: Let's detour along the southern road first.
say:2:1111112003:0.female: Let's detour along the southern road first.

say:3:1111112004:0.text: Satrana, what made you lose your temper so badly just now?
say:3:1111112004:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜，你刚才突然发那么大脾气，是怎么了？

say:4:1111112005:0.text: For the Quicksand Claws to take away their free will and force them to work...
say:4:1111112005:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪竟然违背大家的意志，强迫大家劳役……

say:5:1111112006:0.text: This is the most despicable thing anyone could ever do!
say:5:1111112006:0.source_cn: 在我看来，这是世界上最不可饶恕的事！

say:3:1111114001:0.text: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!
say:3:1111114001:0.source_cn: 刚才警戒号角响了，就是因为你们吧！
say:3:1111114001:0.male: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!
say:3:1111114001:0.female: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!

say:4:1111114002:0.text: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.
say:4:1111114002:0.source_cn: 有意思，有意思！你们一来，营地都变热闹了！
say:4:1111114002:0.male: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.
say:4:1111114002:0.female: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.

say:6:1111114004:0.text: We don't need any more trouble. Look at the aviary behind him—he's just a bird-keeper.
say:6:1111114004:0.source_cn: 多一事不如少一事，看他身后的鸟场，他只是个饲鸟者。

say:7:1111114005:0.text: We shouldn't fight people unless they're actively standing in our way.
say:7:1111114005:0.source_cn: 只要不拦路，就别浪费时间纠缠。

say:9:1111114007:0.text: Hey, fellas! You're going the wrong way, the boss is towards that direction!
say:9:1111114007:0.source_cn: 嘿！别乱走，那边是头儿在的地方——！

say:1:1111115002:0.text: Hear that? Another signaling horn... the Quicksand Claws definitely know we're here.
say:1:1111115002:0.source_cn: 号角声，传讯的号角。流沙之爪已经知道我们来了。

say:2:1111115003:0.text: Let them come. I welcome the challenge.
say:2:1111115003:0.source_cn: 让他们尽管来，我不惧挑战。

say:0:1111116001:0.text: They're getting close to the main camp!

say:1:1111116002:0.source_cn: 拦下他们！不然我们也要遭殃！

say:0:1111119001:0.text: I hope Satrana's alright! She was so enraged by the Quicksand Claws... I'm worried.
say:0:1111119001:0.source_cn: 希望萨忒娜平安无事！她对流沙之爪突然生了那么大火气，我...

say:1:1111119002:0.text: With her prophetic abilities, she'll be just fine.
say:1:1111119002:0.source_cn: 有预言能力，她会平安无事。

say:2:1111119003:0.text: Look ahead at how panicked those guys are. Ferranc must be near!
say:2:1111119003:0.source_cn: 提高警惕，看流沙之爪的喽啰这么慌张，弗兰克就在前方！

say:3:1111119004:0.text: The time for my revenge... has finally arrived.
say:3:1111119004:0.source_cn: 复仇的时刻……终于要来临了。

say:4:1111120002:1.text: Get lost! No one interrupts me from sharpening my claws with the bones of my prey!
say:4:1111120002:1.source_cn: 滚开，用猎物骨头磨爪子的享乐时间，谁都不许打扰我！

say:5:1111120003:1.text: Lift that chin and meet your maker with some dignity, you varmint.
say:5:1111120003:1.source_cn: 抬起头，堂堂正正地面对你的命运，恶棍！

say:7:1111120005:1.text: What's got you feeling all blue? Me taking care of your partner?
say:7:1111120005:1.source_cn: 为什么拿枪指着我？就因为我料理了你的搭档？

say:8:1111120006:1.text: That miserable, wretched <style="highlight">traitor</style>! I should have snuffed him out long ago!

choice_prompt:9:1111120006.text: That miserable, wretched <style="highlight">traitor</style>! I should have snuffed him out long ago!
choice_prompt:9:1111120006.source_cn: 那个可憎的、羸弱的<style=highlight>叛徒</style>，我早就应该下令处决他！

say:10:1111120007:1.text: Ha! You've come to join this guy in death and he hasn't even told you the truth!
say:10:1111120007:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，你们来陪他送命，这家伙竟然还没告诉你们过去的真相？
say:10:1111120007:1.male: Ha! You've come to join this guy in death and he hasn't even told you the truth!
say:10:1111120007:1.female: Ha! You've come to join this guy in death and he hasn't even told you the truth!

say:13:1111120010:1.text: Wyatt used to be one of us! A Quicksand Claw!
say:13:1111120010:1.source_cn: 怀亚特，以前是我们流沙之爪的人！

say:15:1111120012:1.text: Dealing with traitors has always been so... pleasurable. I could reminisce about it for days on end!
say:15:1111120012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，清理叛徒实在是一件乐事！我愿意讲上三天三夜！

say:16:1111120013:1.text: Before we made this camp, Wyatt was under my command. Then this guy comes along and they buddy up as partners... boring!
say:16:1111120013:1.source_cn: 在找到这个好地方做大本营之前，怀亚特是任老子差使的手下...

say:17:1111120014:1.text: And now you dare to bring outsiders before me?!
say:17:1111120014:1.source_cn: 最后竟然还敢领着外人到我面前？！棺材才是最适合他的地方！

say:18:1111120015:1.text: Sure you want to harp on the past while starin' down the barrel of my gun?
say:18:1111120015:1.source_cn: ……看着我的枪口，你还有闲心回忆过去吗？

say:19:1111120016:1.text: Aww, look, I hit a nerve! Our friend here seems not to want to reminisce any longer.
say:19:1111120016:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧，戳到他的痛处了，咱们共同的老朋友，好像很不想追忆...

say:20:1111120017:1.text: Alright then, if you're in such a rush to die, who am I to stand in your way?
say:20:1111120017:1.source_cn: 好啊，急着送命的话，我不介意让人和你们玩玩！
say:20:1111120017:1.male: Alright then, if you're in such a rush to die, who am I to stand in your way?
say:20:1111120017:1.female: Alright then, if you're in such a rush to die, who am I to stand in your way?

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 怀亚特的牺牲究竟是怎么回事？

say:3:1111124002:1.text: I refuse to believe I got beaten by a bunch of dainty, pathetic, cowards! You're all weak just like Wyatt! I never shoulda let that scum stay in the Claws...
say:3:1111124002:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪的王，输在颓废的、无能的、愚蠢的手下败将和一群...

say:4:1111124003:1.text: Open your eyes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Soren are anything but cowards.
say:4:1111124003:1.male: Open your eyes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Soren are anything but cowards.
say:4:1111124003:1.female: Open your eyes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Soren are anything but cowards.

say:5:1111124004:1.text: And so what if Wyatt was once a Quicksand Claw?
say:5:1111124004:1.source_cn: 继续把话说完，弗兰克。怀亚特曾经是流沙之爪的人，又怎么了？

say:6:1111124005:1.text: He was strong, agile, and kind. He had a heart of gold only a few could uncover.
say:6:1111124005:1.source_cn: 他对气泡水的品味很好，行动也敏捷。他深埋在心中的善意，...

say:7:1111124006:1.text: In the end, he wasn't a Quicksand Claw. He wasn't scum like you!
say:7:1111124006:1.source_cn: 从说想脱离流沙之爪之后，怀亚特就不再是你们的人！

say:8:1111124007:1.text: That little fool... you rot his brain so much he thought that playing house with humans was a respectable way to live.
say:8:1111124007:1.source_cn: 那个小混蛋……他受你影响太多了，竟然觉得和人类混在一起...

say:9:1111124008:1.text: And in the end, you're even attacking me now because of him... I should've skinned his hide for a new pair of boots before I buried him!
say:9:1111124008:1.source_cn: 最后竟然还领你来袭击我……无耻的叛徒，他就应该葬身在我...

say:10:1111124009:1.text: You're the only one headed for six feet under today.
say:10:1111124009:1.source_cn: 今天要葬身的另有其人。

say:11:1111124010:1.text: Time to dance, Ferranc. A duel—just you, and me.
say:11:1111124010:1.source_cn: 来吧，按决斗的规矩——只有你我。单挑。

say:12:1111124011:1.text: Silence! You'll never beat the greatest Quicksand Claw to ever live!
say:12:1111124011:1.source_cn: 闭嘴、闭嘴、闭嘴！流沙之爪的王绝不会输在你手上！！

say:5:1111125002:1.text: It's... hard to say. I think I did what I needed to do.
say:5:1111125002:1.source_cn: 或许吧……我不知道。我自认做了应做的事。

say:6:1111125003:1.text: When it all went down, Ferranc set up an ambush for me and Wyatt and told him to put a bullet in me to save his own hide.
say:6:1111125003:1.source_cn: 当年行动时，弗兰克设下埋伏，把我和怀亚特包围起来，命令...

say:7:1111125004:1.source_cn: 但是，最后怀亚特没对我下手。

say:8:1111125005:1.text: Just tossed me his gun and said, "Run, big guy!"
say:8:1111125005:1.source_cn: 他把自己的枪抛给我，对我说，“快跑，大块头！”。

choice_prompt:9:1111125005.text: Just tossed me his gun and said, "Run, big guy!"
choice_prompt:9:1111125005.source_cn: 他把自己的枪抛给我，对我说，“快跑，大块头！”。

say:13:1111125010:1.text: It feels like I got sandbags and lead weights tied to me... Reckon it'll be mighty tough to move forward at first.
say:13:1111125010:1.source_cn: 身上绑着沙袋和铅块绑在身上，最开始会沉重到几乎无法行动。

say:14:1111125011:1.text: Maybe you just learn to live with it. Brush off the dust, start huntin' bounties again, and sit out yonder in Alkali, watchin' the sun sink low.
say:14:1111125011:1.source_cn: 可是不知道什么时候，你开始习惯，开始像往常一样喝气泡水...

say:15:1111125012:1.text: But deep down, you know no amount of payback can ever ease that burden... Guess that's how I'm feelin'.
say:15:1111125012:1.source_cn: 你知道那些重量还在，而且永远无法卸除。即便复仇的子弹击...

say:16:1111125013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I owe you and Soren a heap of thanks. It's because of you I made it this far.
say:16:1111125013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I owe you and Soren a heap of thanks. It's because of you I made it this far.
say:16:1111125013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I owe you and Soren a heap of thanks. It's because of you I made it this far.

say:20:1111125016:1.text: Oh, it was all just a bit of fun. They were more bark than bite. Once they caught sight of you charging towards Ferranc's main camp, most of 'em skittered off like scared rabbits.
say:20:1111125016:1.source_cn: 没什么没什么，那些流沙之爪只是声势浩大，看到你们真的往...

say:21:1111125017:1.text: Anyways... Because Ferranc only ruled through tyranny, he never considered the meaning of companionship.
say:21:1111125017:1.source_cn: 因为弗兰克只靠暴戾统治，从来没有考虑过同伴的含义。

say:22:1111125018:1.text: This was the ending he deserved.

say:23:1111125019:1.text: Ah, revenge served, anger vented... feels like a weight lifted, doesn't it? Heading back to Alkali, are you? Well, I was just—
say:23:1111125019:1.source_cn: 仇也报了，气也出了，真是爽快！你们是不是要回咸水镇？那...
say:23:1111125019:1.male: Ah, revenge served, anger vented... feels like a weight lifted, doesn't it? Heading back to Alkali, are you? Well, I was just—
say:23:1111125019:1.female: Ah, revenge served, anger vented... feels like a weight lifted, doesn't it? Heading back to Alkali, are you? Well, I was just—

say:24:1111125020:1.text: —Huh? Why has the aura suddenly become chaotic? It should've been a happy ending all around!
say:24:1111125020:1.source_cn: ——嗯？气运为什么突然变得混乱了？明明应该是皆大欢喜的...

choice_prompt:25:1111125020.text: —Huh? Why has the aura suddenly become chaotic? It should've been a happy ending all around!
choice_prompt:25:1111125020.source_cn: ——嗯？气运为什么突然变得混乱了？明明应该是皆大欢喜的结局才对呀！

say:26:1111125022:0.text: I sense something to the west, but whether it's good or bad, I can't tell. Is it the wind? Or perhaps an opportunity that shouldn't be ignored? I need time to decipher!
say:26:1111125022:0.source_cn: ……西边，我感觉西边有东西，但是好是坏，现在还说不清。...

say:27:1111125023:1.text: Let's not waste time deciphering. We'll find out if we just go there.

say:28:1111125024:1.text: You always think too much, and move too little.
say:28:1111125024:1.source_cn: 你们总是想得太多，动得太少。
say:28:1111125024:1.male: You always think too much, and move too little.
say:28:1111125024:1.female: You always think too much, and move too little.

say:30:1111125021:0.text: No, the threads of his fate have already been severed...
say:30:1111125021:0.source_cn: 不，他命运的丝线已经被截断了……

choice:19:2:3.text: What would we do without you?
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 不愧是受命运眷顾的预言师
choice:19:2:3.male: What would we do without you?
choice:19:2:3.female: What would we do without you?

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 因为你是他珍重的搭档

say:31:1111125007:1.text: Was, yeah. It's old, lags a little, but it's a good gun nonetheless.
say:31:1111125007:1.source_cn: 是他的。最后到了我手里。旧了，有点卡壳，但那真是把好枪。

say:0:1111126001:0.text: The boss' tent is a mess!
say:0:1111126001:0.source_cn: 头儿营帐那边，乱糟糟的！

say:1:1111126002:0.text: Should we take a look...? Nah, better not get involved!
say:1:1111126002:0.source_cn: 过去看看吗……不，不能多事！

say:0:1111127001:0.text: Satrana is brilliant! There really are Quicksand Claw guards here!
say:0:1111127001:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜好灵验！这里真的有流沙之爪在看守！

say:1:1111127002:0.text: Perhaps there's something really important inside the cave?
say:1:1111127002:0.source_cn: 他们后面的山洞里，莫非藏着很重要的东西？

say:1:1111128002:0.text: Well now, ain't that a sight? Still got a guard posted outside... What's Ferranc hiding?
say:1:1111128002:0.source_cn: 这可有意思。外面还在派人把守，弗兰克在藏匿什么？

say:0:1111129001:0.text: Looks like Ferranc stashed all the tools and loot for plunderin' treasure right here.
say:0:1111129001:0.source_cn: 看起来，弗兰克把劫掠来寻宝的工具和货物都储藏在这里了。

say:1:1111129002:0.text: If that was all, there would be no need for a guard.
say:1:1111129002:0.source_cn: ……如果只是这些，完全不必派人看管。
say:1:1111129002:0.male: If that was all, there would be no need for a guard.
say:1:1111129002:0.female: If that was all, there would be no need for a guard.

say:2:1111129003:0.text: Look carefully for any other clues.
say:2:1111129003:0.source_cn: 仔细看看有没有特殊的东西或者线索。
say:2:1111129003:0.male: Look carefully for any other clues.
say:2:1111129003:0.female: Look carefully for any other clues.

say:3:1111130001:1.text: Magister, Chippy found a treasure map!
say:3:1111130001:1.source_cn: 主人，满满发现了一张藏宝图！！
say:3:1111130001:1.male: Magister, Chippy found a treasure map!
say:3:1111130001:1.female: Magister, Chippy found a treasure map!

say:4:1111130002:2.text: A treasure map? Can't say I've laid eyes on a Mauler treasure map before.
say:4:1111130002:2.source_cn: 藏宝图？蛮血的藏宝图我倒是第一次见。

say:5:1111130003:0.text: Three spots are marked. Does this point to treasure in the Crimson Highlands?
say:5:1111130003:0.source_cn: 标记了三处地点。这是深红高原宝藏的分布图？

say:6:1111130004:1.text: Information on bounties and treasure is more often than not full of holes.
say:6:1111130004:1.source_cn: 悬赏、寻宝，拿到的情报常常不准。

say:7:1111130005:1.text: From my experience, that mark in the middle stands apart from the rest. Might be where them Quicksand Claws reckon the real treasure's hidin'. The other two spots seem dubious.
say:7:1111130005:1.source_cn: 从我的经验看，中间那个显眼的标记与众不同，也许流沙之爪...

say:8:1111130006:1.text: If it truly is a treasure map, no wonder they're guardin' it so fiercely.
say:8:1111130006:1.source_cn: 如果是藏宝图，那的确是非常重要的情报，不能随便被人得知...

say:9:1111130007:1.text: So in order to dig the treasure up, they robbed a cache of tools from everyone?
say:9:1111130007:1.source_cn: 为了挖掘宝藏，就到处劫人，抢夺挖掘工具？

say:0:1111131001:0.text: Besides the tools and map, is there anything else here?
say:0:1111131001:0.source_cn: 除了藏宝图和挖掘工具，这里还有别的东西吗？
say:0:1111131001:0.male: Besides the tools and map, is there anything else here?
say:0:1111131001:0.female: Besides the tools and map, is there anything else here?

say:1:1111131002:0.text: It can't be that straightforward. Let's give it another once-over.

say:3:1111132001:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate! I knew it, the guy we saw in Alkali was definitely suspicious!
say:3:1111132001:1.source_cn: ——黑金商会！果然我们在咸水镇集市见到的那家店并不简单！

say:4:1111132002:1.text: Even if the owner of that weapons shop has nothing to do with this conspiracy, the tendrils of the Adamant Syndicate have already reached here!
say:4:1111132002:1.source_cn: 就算那个武器店老板和这次的阴谋无关，黑金商会的触角也已...

say:5:1111132003:1.text: You've been talking about the Adamant Syndicate all day. What are they like?
say:5:1111132003:1.source_cn: 你们一路都在说黑金，究竟怎么回事？

choice_prompt:6:1111132003.text: You've been talking about the Adamant Syndicate all day. What are they like?
choice_prompt:6:1111132003.source_cn: 你们一路都在说黑金，究竟怎么回事？

say:7:1111132004:1.text: Are you saying that Berial was actually liberated by the Adamant Syndicate?!
say:7:1111132004:1.source_cn: 你是说，贝利尔是黑金商会解放的？！

say:8:1111132005:1.text: That foul Hypogean, treating our Warsong Festival as a mere game and trampling on the dignity of the participants.
say:8:1111132005:1.source_cn: 那个可恶的恶魔，竟敢把我们最盛大的战歌节当成一场随便操...

say:9:1111132006:1.text: I didn't even get the chance to wring his neck!
say:9:1111132006:1.source_cn: 我甚至没能来得及给他一拳……！

say:13:1111132007:1.text: Huh, Hypogean?! Hold it! Don't utter that word again, or you'll sour even the sweetest luck you've got!
say:13:1111132007:1.source_cn: 咦，恶魔？！\n——不不不，不能提这个词，太不吉利了！

say:14:1111132008:1.text: So you've actually seen one of those... creatures?
say:14:1111132008:1.source_cn: 你们曾经见过那些……那种……生物？

say:15:1111132009:1.text: Don't be nervous! This is not the first time we've faced Hypogeans. Under the magister's guidance, Soren received the Mark of the Setting Sun and can confront them head-on!
say:15:1111132009:1.source_cn: 别紧张，我们不是第一次面对恶魔了。索恩在主人的引导下，...
say:15:1111132009:1.male: Don't be nervous! This is not the first time we've faced Hypogeans. Under the magister's guidance, Soren received the Mark of the Setting Sun and can confront them head-on!
say:15:1111132009:1.female: Don't be nervous! This is not the first time we've faced Hypogeans. Under the magister's guidance, Soren received the Mark of the Setting Sun and can confront them head-on!

say:16:1111132010:1.text: Stop! Don't repeat that word again, otherwise even the good luck you wear will be tarnished with black omens!
say:16:1111132010:1.source_cn: 别！别再重复那个词，否则连你们身上的好运也会被逆转成凶兆！

say:17:1111132011:1.text: A crimson tide and horrible black spikes... could the terrifying vision I had be connected to those evil beasts...?
say:17:1111132011:1.source_cn: 深红之潮和黑色的尖峰，震颤的大地与哭泣的人……我之前看...

choice_prompt:18:1111132011.text: A crimson tide and horrible black spikes... could the terrifying vision I had be connected to those evil beasts...?
choice_prompt:18:1111132011.source_cn: 深红之潮和黑色的尖峰，震颤的大地与哭泣的人……我之前看到的可怖预兆，难道和那些邪恶的生物有关……

say:19:1111132012:1.text: ... Perhaps. Regardless, stop saying that word!
say:19:1111132012:1.source_cn: 感觉……也许……总之别提那个词！

say:22:1111132013:1.text: The letter says the treasure in the Crimson Highlands is at the resting place of the Dusk Lord. The map also marks an excavation site.
say:22:1111132013:1.source_cn: 唔，信上说深红高原的宝藏在残阳神的长眠地。藏宝图上也标...

say:23:1111132014:1.text: If it's really related to the Adamant Syndicate, then there must be something wrong with the treasure in the Crimson Highlands! Who knows, maybe we'll even see Berial there.
say:23:1111132014:1.source_cn: 如果真的与黑金商会有关，那么深红高原的宝藏一定有问题！...

choice_prompt:24:1111132014.text: If it's really related to the Adamant Syndicate, then there must be something wrong with the treasure in the Crimson Highlands! Who knows, maybe we'll even see Berial there.
choice_prompt:24:1111132014.source_cn: 如果真的与黑金商会有关，那么深红高原的宝藏一定有问题！说不定我们还能在那里见到贝利尔呢。

say:25:1111132015:1.text: Berial... he needs to pay for toying with us.
say:25:1111132015:1.source_cn: 贝利尔……要让他为玩弄我们付出代价。

say:26:1111132016:1.text: Things are gettin' murkier by the second. If you're headin' to the Crimson Highlands, you better be ready. It won't be a stroll in the park.
say:26:1111132016:1.source_cn: 听起来事情越来越复杂了，你们要是去深红高原，得做好准备...
say:26:1111132016:1.male: Things are gettin' murkier by the second. If you're headin' to the Crimson Highlands, you better be ready. It won't be a stroll in the park.
say:26:1111132016:1.female: Things are gettin' murkier by the second. If you're headin' to the Crimson Highlands, you better be ready. It won't be a stroll in the park.

say:27:1111132017:1.text: I don't think we've hit the end of this passage yet. Let's keep our eyes peeled for more clues.
say:27:1111132017:1.source_cn: 我看这条密道还没走到底，前面还有可通行的地方，不如继续...

say:28:1111132018:1.text: Ferranc, that lowlife, really left us a mess.
say:28:1111132018:1.source_cn: 弗兰克这混蛋，真是给我们准备了好大的惊喜……

choice:24:1:2.text: Hmm, that might be a good idea.
choice:24:1:2.male: Hmm, that might be a good idea.
choice:24:1:2.female: Hmm, that might be a good idea.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 你知道预言中的地点吗？

choice:18:1:2.text: A vision caused by the Hypogeans?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 你看到的景象，是恶魔导致的吗？
choice:18:1:2.male: A vision caused by the Hypogeans?
choice:18:1:2.female: A vision caused by the Hypogeans?

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: （讲述黑金在日神殿放出贝利尔的过往）

choice:6:1:2.text: Let me tell you about Berial...
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: （痛斥黑金过去所有的所作所为！）
choice:6:1:2.male: Let me tell you about Berial...
choice:6:1:2.female: Let me tell you about Berial...

say:0:1111133001:0.text: Look below! It's the cave where we first rescued the caravan members!
say:0:1111133001:0.source_cn: 看下面，下面就是我们最早救出商队成员的掠金洞窟！

say:1:1111133002:0.text: So the gold plundering cave is connected to the Quicksand Claw turf.
say:1:1111133002:0.source_cn: 原来掠金洞窟和流沙之爪的大本营相连。

say:2:1111133003:0.text: Hmph. We were just one step away.

say:0:1111134001:0.text: What a long passage! Deeper than the deepest hole Chippy has ever dug!
say:0:1111134001:0.source_cn: 好长的密道，比满满挖过最长的地洞都长！

say:0:1111135001:0.text: Is that light up ahead the exit to the passage?
say:0:1111135001:0.source_cn: 前面那道光是密道的出口吗？

say:1:1111135002:0.text: Thanks to the hand of fate, we've made it out at last!
say:1:1111135002:0.source_cn: 感谢命运的指引，我们终于能出去了！
say:1:1111135002:0.male: Thanks to the hand of fate, we've made it out at last!
say:1:1111135002:0.female: Thanks to the hand of fate, we've made it out at last!

say:1:1111136002:0.text: This stone here looks mighty familiar. If memory serves, we're on the south side of Alkali.
say:1:1111136002:0.source_cn: 周围的砂岩很眼熟，没猜错的话，咱们在咸水镇南侧。

say:2:1111136003:0.text: Everyone is weary from the journey. Let's head into Alkali and rest before making further plans.
say:2:1111136003:0.source_cn: 这一路大家也累了，先回咸水镇再做打算吧。
say:2:1111136003:0.male: Everyone is weary from the journey. Let's head into Alkali and rest before making further plans.
say:2:1111136003:0.female: Everyone is weary from the journey. Let's head into Alkali and rest before making further plans.

say:0:1111137001:0.text: Chippy remembers this road very well! This is indeed the way to Alkali!
say:0:1111137001:0.source_cn: 这条路，满满记得！确实是通向咸水镇的路！

say:1:1111137002:0.text: It seems the Quicksand Claws rely on secret passages to traverse the area.
say:1:1111137002:0.source_cn: 原来流沙之爪就是靠这些密道在各个区域穿梭。
say:1:1111137002:0.male: It seems the Quicksand Claws rely on secret passages to traverse the area.
say:1:1111137002:0.female: It seems the Quicksand Claws rely on secret passages to traverse the area.

say:3:1111138001:0.text: Time flies when you're on the trail, folks. And it's time for me to mosey on.
say:3:1111138001:0.source_cn: 时间总是转瞬即逝，各位，该说再见了。
say:3:1111138001:0.male: Time flies when you're on the trail, folks. And it's time for me to mosey on.
say:3:1111138001:0.female: Time flies when you're on the trail, folks. And it's time for me to mosey on.

say:4:1111138002:0.text: You're leaving? You won't come to the Crimson Highlands with us?
say:4:1111138002:0.source_cn: 你要走了？不一起去深红高原吗？

say:5:1111138003:1.text: Treasure huntin's for the young 'uns. I'll leave that to you lot.
say:5:1111138003:1.source_cn: 寻宝是年轻人的浪漫，大叔就不参与了。

say:6:1111138004:1.text: But listen up and consider this my last bit of advice: the Crimson Highlands ain't short on surprises. Even if you're capable, you best keep your wits about you.
say:6:1111138004:1.source_cn: 另外……算是我最后的忠告吧：深红高原危机四伏，就算你们...
say:6:1111138004:1.male: But listen up and consider this my last bit of advice: the Crimson Highlands ain't short on surprises. Even if you're capable, you best keep your wits about you.
say:6:1111138004:1.female: But listen up and consider this my last bit of advice: the Crimson Highlands ain't short on surprises. Even if you're capable, you best keep your wits about you.

say:8:1111138006:1.source_cn: 口气还是这么狂妄啊，小兄弟。

say:9:1111138007:0.text: You should expect that by now.
say:9:1111138007:0.source_cn: 你也不是第一天认识他了。

say:10:1111138008:0.text: Well, you've got a long road ahead. I won't hold you up any longer.
say:10:1111138008:0.source_cn: 好吧，你们还有事要忙，我就不留你们了。
say:10:1111138008:0.male: Well, you've got a long road ahead. I won't hold you up any longer.
say:10:1111138008:0.female: Well, you've got a long road ahead. I won't hold you up any longer.

say:11:1111138009:0.text: Look me up when you get back from the Crimson Highlands. We'll find a spot and swap tales.
say:11:1111138009:0.source_cn: 等你们从深红高原回来，我们找个地方聚一聚，我很乐意听你...
say:11:1111138009:0.male: Look me up when you get back from the Crimson Highlands. We'll find a spot and swap tales.
say:11:1111138009:0.female: Look me up when you get back from the Crimson Highlands. We'll find a spot and swap tales.

say:13:1111138011:0.text: Of course! Do I look stingy to you?
say:13:1111138011:0.source_cn: 当然！我像是那种小气的男人吗？

say:14:1111138012:0.text: Speaking of which, since you all lent me a hand back there—
say:14:1111138012:0.source_cn: 说起来，这次复仇还是你们帮了我一把。

say:17:1111138014:0.text: Don't need to be so polite. Consider it a token of appreciation.
say:17:1111138014:0.male: Don't need to be so polite. Consider it a token of appreciation.
say:17:1111138014:0.female: Don't need to be so polite. Consider it a token of appreciation.

say:18:1111138016:0.text: Well, that's all she wrote. Try not to miss me too much.
say:18:1111138016:0.source_cn: 行啦，就在这里分别吧，你们可不要太想我。
say:18:1111138016:0.male: Well, that's all she wrote. Try not to miss me too much.
say:18:1111138016:0.female: Well, that's all she wrote. Try not to miss me too much.

say:19:1111138017:1.text: So much talk. If you're going, go.

say:25:1111138021:1.text: Now that he's gone, who's going to banter with Soren now?
say:25:1111138021:1.source_cn: 哎呀……大叔走了，都没人跟索恩抬杠了。

choice_prompt:26:1111138021.text: Now that he's gone, who's going to banter with Soren now?
choice_prompt:26:1111138021.source_cn: 哎呀……大叔走了，都没人跟索恩抬杠了。

say:27:1111138022:1.text: That's right! I think we'll have plenty of fun!
say:27:1111138022:1.source_cn: 说得对！我想，这一路依旧会很热闹的。

say:29:1111138015:0.text: It's a dime a dozen for the locals. Take it as a keepsake.
say:29:1111138015:0.source_cn: 这东西对本地人而言太常见了，还是你留着做个纪念吧。
say:29:1111138015:0.male: It's a dime a dozen for the locals. Take it as a keepsake.
say:29:1111138015:0.female: It's a dime a dozen for the locals. Take it as a keepsake.

narration:0:1111140001:1.text: Carley, Jerry, and Ugar come out of the cages and stretch their bodies.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111101002:.text: So, my prophecy was spot on.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1111101002:.source_cn: 哼哼，我的预言果然没错

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111101003:.text: The ground is red and rocky here!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111101004:.text: Quicksand Claws, just you wait and see.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111113002:.text: Plumecharger, why are you being so loud?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111113004:.text: Aha, it looks like I've stumbled across something fun!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1111113004:.source_cn: 哈，有不要命的家伙来了！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111118009:.text: You rotten scum who would dare enslave others...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1111118010:.text: Not a single one of you will be spared!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1111118010:.source_cn: 我绝对绝对绝对不会饶过你们！！
